items.title: Greater Albuquerque Bicycling Advisory Committee Meeting Minutes — January 12, 2015
items.description: Minutes document GABAC’s January 2015 discussion of PdN/I-25 bicycle-access concerns, the Bikeways and Trails Facilities Plan schedule, MLK improvements, construction impacts, facility audits, and the NMDOT Rio Bravo/I-25 project.

items.title: Greater Albuquerque Bicycling Advisory Committee Meeting Minutes — December 14, 2015
